definitions.explanation: A person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{映画|えいが}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a movie with a friend.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{友達|ともだち}ができた。
{友達|ともだち}の{家|いえ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to my friend's house.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}のとき、{友達|ともだち}と{毎日|まいにち}{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: When I was in elementary school, I played with my friends every day.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{出会|であ}った{友達|ともだち}とは、{今|いま}でも{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}り{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: I still keep in touch with friends I met in university.

notes: General term for friend. Related: {親友|しんゆう} (close friend, best friend), {友人|ゆうじん} (friend, more formal).
